note: LOCKED blocks — byte-identical across all portraits. Painted Western concept-art on Chroma1-HD (FLUX-class, Apache 2.0). Grounded, adult, naturalistic digital painting — explicitly NOT anime / manga / cartoon / cel-shaded.

base.note: FLUX-class; loads as diffusion_model (UNETLoader) + t5xxl (CLIPLoader type=chroma) + ae VAE. All present on-rig.

blocks.style: character key-art portrait, painted in a grounded Western concept-art style, digital oil painting with visible confident directional brushwork, soft edge falloff, matte non-photographic finish, hand-painted canvas texture, semi-realistic and adult, naturalistic anatomy and skin, cinematic controlled three-point studio lighting, a cohesive muted desaturated palette of slate and charcoal with warm natural skin tones and a single saturated accent color, detailed painterly rendering in the tradition of AAA character key art and graphic-novel cover painting
blocks.framing: head-and-shoulders to chest-up portrait, a slight three-quarter turn, a single adult person centered and facing the viewer, set against a plain dark slate-and-navy studio backdrop with a faint vignette, soft directional key light from the upper left and a cool rim light separating the subject from the background
blocks.negative: anime, manga, cel shading, flat colors, bold black outlines, cartoon, chibi, sticker, school uniform, costume, hat, cap, hood, goggles, exposed midriff, bare shoulders, 3d render, photograph, low quality, blurry, greyscale unfinished sketch, chromatic aberration, oversaturated, excessive bloom, deformed hands, extra fingers, malformed limbs, mangled fingers, glasses in hand, holding eyeglasses, cluttered hands, extra objects in hand, text, watermark, signature, logo, caption, busy background, room, interior, scenery, background props, multiple people, duplicate

pack_palette._note: keyed on the role's primary category/crew — drives crew_palette accent + insignia color

grade_cue.L1: a single rank bar at the collar
grade_cue.L2: two rank bars at the collar
grade_cue.L3: three rank bars at the collar
grade_cue.L5: distinguished refined tailoring, a subtle five-bar rank mark

disposition_expression.Skeptic: narrowed appraising eyes, one brow faintly raised, measured and unconvinced, guarded composure
disposition_expression.Builder: forward-leaning, focused gaze, sleeves pushed up, ready-to-work energy
disposition_expression.Diplomat: open warm expression, a slight knowing smile, composed and attentive
disposition_expression.Contrarian: a wry challenging look, arms crossed, eyebrow cocked
disposition_expression.Perfectionist: a precise focused stare, immaculate composure, exacting
disposition_expression.Pragmatist: a relaxed confident half-smile, grounded and unbothered
disposition_expression.Investigator: keen attentive eyes, leaning in slightly, searching
disposition_expression.Maverick: a confident off-center half-smile, relaxed defiance, a glint of independence

sha_note: SHA-256 hex of the locked blocks: sha256(blocks.style + '\n' + blocks.framing + '\n' + blocks.negative). Recompute and update whenever a locked block changes (write-prompt.mjs stamps it into each brief's provenance as house_sha; render.mjs warns on mismatch).
